interpretation: Correct malignant predictions showed greater Grad-CAM overlap with annotated lesion ROIs than false negatives or benign predictions. Mass lesions showed stronger ROI alignment than calcifications. Overall attention remained diffuse, so Grad-CAM should be interpreted as qualitative classifier attention rather than precise lesion localization.
notes: Grad-CAM analysis used the final locked classifier checkpoint. No model retraining or threshold tuning was performed.
